My bass sits at 148 % stereo width. Measured, it's mono.

BASS D in Uhrwerk aus Blut: Serum 2, Saturator, EQ Eight, then Utility at 148 % width with Bass Mono at 120 Hz. In the drop the side signal sits 43 dB under the middle, left/right correlation 1.00 in every band.

Width only scales the difference between left and right. The signal reaching Utility is already the same on both sides, so there is nothing to widen.

Bass Mono off: same level, correlation still 1.00. In the full drop, everything below 120 Hz measures correlation 1.00.

Uhrwerk aus Blut is out now. New Psychedelic Death Art at 210 BPM. Mastering: link in bio.

Do you get bass width from the source or from a width knob?

#sounddesign #mixing #abletonlive #newpsychedelicdeathart

Same bass, same 12 dB of drive. Only the saturation type changes.

I put Crucible on the bass of my 210 BPM track, all three bands on the same type, 12 dB of drive each, and matched every take to the same loudness. Then I measured how much of the sound sits between 3 and 12 kHz compared with the dry bass:

Tape +2.3 dB
Tube +1.4 dB
Diode +1.8 dB
Hard Clip +3.4 dB
Wavefolder +6.3 dB

Same knob, five different characters.

Crucible: 3-band saturation, five types per band, oversampling up to 8x, VST3 for Windows. The demo is the complete plugin with a short quiet noise burst every 45 seconds. Link in bio.

Which type would you put on your bass?

DE: Gleicher Bass, gleiche 12 dB Drive, nur der Sättigungstyp wechselt. Pegelgleich gemessen, Anteil 3–12 kHz gegenüber dem trockenen Bass: Tape +2,3 dB, Tube +1,4, Diode +1,8, Hard Clip +3,4, Wavefolder +6,3. Demo gratis, Link in der Bio.
